summary: Hadron Energy, Inc. (formerly GigCapital7 Corp.) filed an 8-K to report the consummation of its business combination with Hadron Energy Operating Company Inc. on May 22, 2026. Approximately 84% of public shares (16,834,491 shares) were redeemed for cash at $10.71267171 per share, totaling $180.3 million. Post-combination, the company has 71,498,842 common shares issued and outstanding, along with public and private warrants exercisable at $11.50 per share. The combination closed following shareholder approval at a May 7, 2026 extraordinary meeting. This de-SPAC transaction completes the merger with the target operating company. Watch for potential warrant overhang and post-merger trading liquidity as the combined entity begins operations.
